name: Cup and handle rim break
idea: A swing high, a cup back to it after the set number of bars, a shallow handle, then a signal on the first close above the rim. The mirror: an inverted cup under its rim. Wrong beyond the handle.

params.label: Swing size (the swing degree read)
params.help: Which swings are read: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history. Reference: 0.

params.label: Bars for the average true range the tolerances are measured in
params.help: Bars for the average true range the tolerances are measured in. Reference: 14.

params.label: Cup: bars from the left rim to the right rim, at least
params.help: Bars from the first rim to the second, at least. Reference: 15.

params.label: Cup: the right rim within this share of the cup's depth of the left rim
params.help: The second rim within this share of the cup's depth of the first. Reference: 0.1.

params.label: Cup: the handle at most this share of the cup's depth
params.help: The handle at most this share of the cup's depth. Reference: 0.5.

params.label: Bars a pattern stays watched
params.help: Bars a pattern stays watched (after its pullback, its second low or its second rim). Reference: 30.

params.label: Cup: only with volume on the close above the rim
params.help: Only with volume on the close beyond the rim (an index uses its near-month future's volume).

params.label: Cup: that volume at least this many times the average
params.help: That volume at least this many times the average. Reference: 1.

params.label: Bars for the average range and volume
params.help: Bars for the average range (and the average volume). Reference: 20.

setup.long: PricePattern("cup_handle", "up", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, cup_bars=$cup_bars, rim_tol=$rim_tol, handle_max=$handle_max, expiry=$expiry, vol_confirm=$vol_confirm, vol_k=$vol_k, avg_n=$avg_n)
setup.short: PricePattern("cup_handle", "down", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, cup_bars=$cup_bars, rim_tol=$rim_tol, handle_max=$handle_max, expiry=$expiry, vol_confirm=$vol_confirm, vol_k=$vol_k, avg_n=$avg_n)

invalidation.short: PricePatternLevel("cup_void", degree=$degree, atr_n=$atr_n, cup_bars=$cup_bars, rim_tol=$rim_tol, handle_max=$handle_max, expiry=$expiry, vol_confirm=$vol_confirm, vol_k=$vol_k, avg_n=$avg_n)
